sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è risk-off a causa dell'aumento del prezzo del petrolio e delle tensioni geopolitiche. Il VIX è a 18.57, il DXY è a 98.91 e il TLT è in calo. L'S&P 500 è poco mosso (-0.04%).
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is risk-off due to rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions. VIX is at 18.57, DXY at 98.91, and TLT is down. S&P 500 is slightly lower (-0.04%).

market_impact_summary.it: Il mercato azionario è poco mosso, con l'S&P 500 in calo dello 0.04%. Il prezzo del petrolio è in aumento, con il Brent a $104.59. Le obbligazioni sono in calo, con il TLT a 85.70. La valuta digitale Bitcoin è poco mossa (+0.39%).
market_impact_summary.en: The stock market is slightly lower, with S&P 500 down 0.04%. Oil prices are rising, with Brent at $104.59. Bonds are down, with TLT at 85.70. Cryptocurrency Bitcoin is little changed (+0.39%).

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.

Il Nikkei ha chiuso in calo dell'1.06%, Shanghai in rialzo dello 0.11%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura debole per i mercati europei.

S&P 500 in calo dello 0.04%, VIX in discesa dell'1.28%. L'oro è sopra i 4600 dollari, in rialzo dell'1.4%. Il petrolio brent crolla dell'11.39% a 104.59 dollari. I rendimenti: US 10Y Yield in rialzo a 4.41%, BTP 10Y stabile a 3.39%.

Le borse europee sono in rosso a causa dello stallo nei negoziati con l'Iran. Il prezzo del greggio tocca il massimo da 4 anni.

Oggi, attenzione ai dati PCE Core YoY negli USA e al PIL dell'Eurozona. La BCE dovrebbe mantenere invariati i tassi. La Fed ha lasciato i tassi invariati, Powell resterà nel board.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. 
  Bitcoin si mantiene sopra i settantacinquemila dollari, dopo una variazione del -1,30% nella giornata odierna. 
  I flussi degli ETF hanno registrato una defluizione di 137,6 milioni di dollari. 
  Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato dalle recenti dichiarazioni della Fed riguardo all'incertezza nel Medio Oriente.

  Tra le altcoin, Ethereum scende del -2,89% a duemiladuecentocinquantasette dollari, Solana del -1,80% a ottantatré virgola diciotto dollari e BNB del -1,24% a seicentodiciassette virgola sessantadue dollari.

  Il Fear & Greed Index è a 29, in zona Fear, suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Sui mercati attendiamo i dati economici in uscita. Per approfondire, trovate gli articoli completi sulla nostra piattaforma. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en:
Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. 

The Nikkei closed down 1.06%, Shanghai up 0.11%. This suggests a weak opening for European markets.

S&P 500 down 0.04%, VIX down 1.28%. Gold is above $4600, up 1.4%. Brent crude collapses 11.39% to $104.59 Yields: US 10Y Yield up to 4.41%, BTP 10Y stable at 3.39%.

European stock markets are in the red due to the stall in negotiations with Iran. The crude price hits a 4-year high.

Today, attention to PCE Core YoY data in the USA and Eurozone GDP. The ECB is expected to keep rates unchanged. The Fed has left rates unchanged, Powell will stay on the board.

Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets... 
  Bitcoin stays above seventy-five thousand dollars, after a variation of -1.3% today. 
  ETF flows have recorded an outflow of $137.6 million. 
  This movement could be influenced by recent Fed statements regarding uncertainty in the Middle East.

  Among altcoins, Ethereum down -2.89% to $2257, Solana down -1.8% to $83.18 and BNB down -1.24% to $617.62

  The Fear & Greed Index is at 29, in Fear zone, suggests caution on investors.

We are waiting for economic data to be released. For more details, find the full articles on our platform. Thanks for your attention and see you tomorrow.

Curbs on trade in cutting-edge chips could determine who wins the artificial intelligence (AI) race. From identifying supply chain vulnerabilities to installing…

articles.title: Beware of Government by AI
articles.snippet: As countries like the United Arab Emirates increasingly delegate decision-making to algorithms, often with little transparency, the risks are no longer hypothetical. Evidence shows these systems can cause widespread harm, erode democratic accountability, and concentrate power in the hands of tech titans.

articles.title: Book launch: World War Trade: Conflict, Containment, and the Emergent World Trading Order
articles.snippet: Globalization is not dying. It is being rebuilt. When the United States and China weaponized trade in 2025, many feared the collapse of the global economy. Markets plunged, supply chains fractured, and policymakers spoke openly of economic warfare. But the collapse never came. In his new book, World War Trade, published by the Centre for Economic Policy Research, Richard Baldwin argues that the real story is not the conflict between superpowers but how the rest of the world responded. Through quiet restraint, strategic adaptation, and a wave of new trade agreements, countries representing the…

articles.title: The Iran War Has Already Destroyed 1.6 Million Bpd in Oil Demand
articles.snippet: The war in the Middle East and the oil price surge it caused have destroyed 1.6 million barrels daily in demand, ING commodity analysts said in a note today, adding that this is nowhere near the rate of supply destruction. This has been estimated at between 13 million bpd and 14 million bpd as of late April, according to various sources, including the International Energy Agency. As talks between the United States and Iran remain suspended with on end of the Strait of Hormuz freeze, traders are starting to realize the supply disruption could last…

articles.title: Oil Rallies Toward $120 As Middle East Supply Risks Spiral
articles.snippet: Oil prices extended their rally on Wednesday after reports emerged that the U.S. will tighten its blockade on Iranian ports, prolonging fears of reduced oil supply from the region, and as the UAE hit markets with its OPEC-exit announcement. Brent crude for June delivery jumped 6.45% to trade at $118.40 per barrel at 2.47 pm ET, while the corresponding WTI crude contract was up 7.20% to change hands at $107.10/bbl. Gasoline prices also continue to edge higher, with AAA reporting the average national price at $4.229 per barrel. The stalemate in the…
